> Chapter 494 Give it a try (Page 1)
Give it a try (Give it a try (p. 22)) As long as the container is completed, it can completely bypass Anahild's cage and return to the world in a complete posture. But now, everything is ruined! The container has been destroyed. If it retreats now, it will be completely pulled back into the cage. Maybe it will not find such a perfect gap to wake up in another thousand or two thousand years. Since it has been forced into a desperate situation by this group of reptiles, since it has been forced to a desperate situation by these reptiles, This container is destined to be scrapped... An extremely crazy and violent determination suddenly ignited in those cold golden vertical eyes. Then give it a try! Even if you can only drag the seriously injured body to an unknown subspace to survive... I will let you understand today what the true master of light is! As if to prove the madness of the giant dragon, the golden dragon shadow suddenly stopped in the air. All movements were stopped. A strange silence instantly enveloped the entire sky of Avalon. Logaris stepped into the void, his eyes suddenly glaring: "Something's wrong!" I saw the huge dragon body began to collapse crazily inward! Under this almost black hole-like gravity, the originally translucent shadow was compressed to less than thirty meters! It actually crossed the boundary of "matter" and turned into substance! Pieces of palm-sized solid gold scales with ancient and clear textures appeared on its surface. A destructive wave that was ten times more terrifying than before spread wildly in all directions with the thirty-meter-long solid golden dragon as the center! Click - click -! Under the extreme pressure of the "demigod", the three people were surrounded. The atmosphere let out an overwhelmed wail. In the face of this sharply rising terrifying pressure, the three seventh-level powerhouses did not flinch. However, at the moment when their respective powers were about to explode, a strong sense of sluggishness suddenly appeared in their bodies. At this moment, the world above a thousand meters high seemed to be given another supreme will. That was the ancient golden dragon. The second authority of the king——! When creation gives the physical body of a god, order takes over the laws of this world. In this space absolutely enveloped by the Golden Dragon King, the underlying rules have been forcibly tampered with. "Mortals should be humble when they see gods!" In the face of the absolute order of the eighth-level demigod, even the seventh-level strong ones who are like natural disasters will be stripped of their extraordinary power in an almost dimension-reducing way. Seizing and suppressing. The thirty-meter-long solid golden dragon was suspended at the top of the sky, and its golden vertical eyes looked down coldly at the three people who were trapped in the mud. It was the crushing of ants by the gods, a suffocating epic feeling of despair, weighing heavily on the ruins of Avalon. Logaris looked up at the "golden sun" that was shrinking rapidly in the sky, like the source of destruction. Wiping away his mocking expression, he sighed quietly in his heart: "It's true that only the Dragon King can fight against the Dragon King..." "But now that we have come to this point, the time should be considered ripe..." The next moment, Logaris' hands suddenly clasped together in front of his chest! A power far older and more vast than his own magic power, following the soul contract signed between him and a certain existence, came against the trend and suddenly came!
